subject.why: The white gift box is clearly depicted with its slightly lifted lid, chunky red satin bow, and blank golden heart tag exactly as briefed.

category.why: The gift box rests on a stylized polished wooden tabletop with a smooth, prop-free warm gradient wall behind it.

clean.why: There are no text, UI elements, watermarks, frames, or characters.

framing.why: The gift box is centrally framed with comfortable breathing room on all sides.

colour.why: The palette is warm, bright, and vibrant, with the white and red gift box popping cleanly off the golden-orange background.

detail.why: Surfaces are kept clean and smooth without photographic textures, noisy patterns, or micro-scratches.

style.why: The rendering features smooth, chunky 3D volumes with soft satin highlights consistent with the reference cards.
